reason: Mechanism verified end-to-end: every wizard inventory bakes the locale-dependent title at creation (Bukkit.createInventory(player, 54, lang.getFor(player, "setup.gui-spawns-overview-title")) at SetupWizard.java:408-409, plus 421-422, 434-435, 614-615, 761-762, 939-940) while onInventoryClick re-derives the expected strings live through lang.getFor -> getPlayerLocale (LanguageManager.java:311-321 and 361-363), so /hilltop lang (HilltopCommandHandler.java:1711-1737, which calls setLocale and setPlayerLocale and never reopens or refreshes a view) changes the comparison string for an already-open inventory; the early return at 1746-1747 sits before event.setCancelled(true) at 1750, so the cancel guard really is skipped. The 'all buttons stop working' half also stands: every other click listener dispatches on a holder or its own inventory instance (ArenaSelectionGUI.java:275, ShopListener.java:86, AbstractAdminMenu.java:74, AbstractConfigMenu.java:159; NumericInputHandler handles only chat and InventoryOpenEvent), so nothing else services clicks in a wizard view, and the cited line numbers plus the ArenaSelectionGUI contrast (line 275) are verbatim correct. Severity is overstated, though: the trigger is an admin running a language command while a wizard GUI is open (or an unpinned personal locale drifting when /hilltop lang changes defaultLocale), which is deliberate and rare, and the failure is self-recovering because the early return never touches sessions or s.step and every chat-button/command path rebuilds the inventory via build*() before openWizardGui (SetupWizard.java:407-447), so closing and reopening restores both the guard and the buttons. Item destruction requires a further deliberate shift-click of the admin's own items into the stalled temp container, and the only movable GUI contents are decorative compass/chest/wool/info items.
